videos.version: Opus 重剪 v2（版面置中）

platforms.label: Instagram
platforms.caption:
If the apps have started to feel like a second job, you're not alone in wanting something slower. Your friends have seen you on good days and messy ones, and they often know who you'd actually click with.
In one survey, 19% of people said they'd trust a close friend most to pick their next date, compared with 3% who'd trust an app. That's one survey and only a direction, but it matches what a lot of us feel.
This week, send one message to one friend. Ask if there's anyone they think you'd get along with, or invite a few people over and ask a friend to bring someone you haven't met. An intro is simply a chance to meet someone new, with someone you trust standing beside you.
Who's the friend you'd text first?
Comment INTRO or 🤝 for a short follow-up note with both message templates.
For a personal reading on your next step in love, visit the link in bio.
For entertainment and self-reflection.

videos.title: They went quiet: one message rule for tonight
videos.version: Opus 重剪 v2（版面置中）
videos.review_summary: 【審閱用】一般主題 Reel：對方突然安靜：今晚的一則訊息規則。Opus 重剪 v2（版面置中），32 秒，文案逐字照核准稿。

platforms.label: Instagram
platforms.caption:
Someone you've been talking to went quiet, or the replies keep running hot and cold. You can spend tonight refreshing the chat, or you can choose one path and let that be enough.
Path A is one clear, kind check-in. Something like: "Hey, I've enjoyed talking with you and I'd like to keep getting to know you. If you're up for that, let me know." You send it once, and then you stop. Their reply, or no reply, is information you can use.
Path B is 72 hours without checking the chat or their profile. When the time is up, you close the loop for yourself by writing one line about what you learned. Maybe it's that you want replies that feel steady. That line belongs to you either way.
In one 2026 dating-app survey, more than a third of people named mixed signals or ghosting as a stressor, so if this is where you are tonight, plenty of people are standing there too.
Your step for tonight: open your notes, write which path you're taking, and do it once.
Comment QUIET or 🤫 for a short follow-up note.
Want a personal reading on what's next for you? Book through the link in bio.
For entertainment and self-reflection.

videos.title: You fantasize about quitting but plan to stay: one decision test this week
videos.version: Opus 重剪 v2（版面置中）
videos.review_summary: 【審閱用】一般主題 Reel：想離職卻打算留下：30 分鐘測試。Opus 重剪 v2（版面置中），31 秒，文案逐字照核准稿。

platforms.label: Instagram
platforms.caption:
You say work is fine. You also catch yourself picturing the day you walk out. And when you're honest, your plan is to stay for now. Holding all three at once can wear you down quietly.
Here is one small test for this week. Book 30 minutes and open a notebook. Answer one question: what would need to change for me to feel engaged here? Write three points. They can be about the work itself, the people, your schedule, or something in you. The page is just for you, and nothing on it has to be decided yet.
The Hermit holds up a lantern to see what's right in front of him. Your three points do the same. What you do with them is your call.
Comment ENGAGE or 📓 for a short follow-up note.
Want a personal reading on where you are right now? The link is in our bio.
For entertainment and self-reflection.

platforms.label: Instagram
platforms.caption:
Some messages sit unread because answering right away would mean performing a calm you don't have yet. Taking space can be a kind thing to do for yourself and the other person, as long as it has an end.
Pause the Reel. Wherever it stops is today's answer.
Whichever you land on, here's something to do today: set a timer for 90 minutes and do one offline thing, like a walk, a shower, or making food. When the timer goes off, answer in three lines or less, or decide when you will and put it in your calendar.
Comment SPACE or 🌙 and I'll send a gentle next step for the reply you're holding.
This is for reference. For a serious question, book a personal reading through the link in bio. For entertainment and self-reflection.

videos.review_summary: 【審閱用】第 1 集題目：這週要不要先傳訊息？開場：IG「如果有個安靜的聊天室一直在你腦子裡轉，停在這裡」，TikTok「這週該先傳嗎？覺得對了就暫停」。

platforms.label: Instagram
platforms.caption:
Should you text first this week? Pause the Reel. Wherever it stops is today's answer.

If you've been opening and closing the same quiet chat, here is one thing to try whichever way it lands. Before you type anything, write one clear sentence of what you actually want from their reply. Read it back. If it still feels true, you'll know what you're reaching out for.

Comment TEXT or 📱 and I'll send what your answer can mean for that first text.

This is for reference. For a serious question, book a personal reading via the link in bio.

For entertainment and self-reflection.
